answer: An island microgrid admits agents only through its copper. Each seat binds to one copper-wound generator, and the operator injects blind load steps randomly. Each must report its rotor dip within three hundred milliseconds; depth and recovery follow that winding copper mass and damping, a curve nobody precomputes. Settlement sits in a vault of certificates: answer truly and it earns, stall and it melts. A thousand puppets demand a thousand spinning rotors on a thousand metered interconnects. One machine serving two seats writes contradictory traces into the same vault, and both forfeit.
